# app-dev

## **Lego Ninjago: Dragons Rising**

Ninjago: Dragons Rising is a series that proceeds after the original *Lego Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu* series. This starts Arin, a young teenager that was one of the victims of the Merge, a catastrophic event that made all of the 16 realms (Ninjago being one of them) merge into one cluttered mess of a realm. Arin, now being mentored under Lloyd, the original main character turned Master of Spinjitzu and Arin's master, now has to handle all of the crazy events that happened after the merge and learn more about the history of the realms.

One of my favourite characters is Sora, a master of Technology who is still learning how to use her elemental powers, while battling her conflicting emotions about her homeplace, the Imperium, and how she was raised.

![Arin and Sora](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/4997444c-1ca1-49b6-8fd0-4ea0e8e98f30/dfvfq0z-6e8c561d-c114-4a37-9940-81c4a84d0907.png/v1/fill/w_1280,h_592,q_80,strp/ninjago_dragons_rising_arin_and_sora__by_fandomcraziness1_dfvfq0z-fullview.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..ux2BvlwhBVQri4mLu2tPhWV2Oi87P17cicXfhM-ybF8)

Another favourite character is Wyldfyre, a master of Heat, not to be confused with Kai, one of the original ninjas who was the master of fire, despite their powers looking similar. She was an orphan thrown out of Imperium and was taken care of by a dragon.

![Kai and Wyldfyre](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/4997444c-1ca1-49b6-8fd0-4ea0e8e98f30/dgr39yl-2af8c73a-5643-4a89-85a5-df7bd97b0fda.png/v1/fill/w_1280,h_592,q_80,strp/ninjago_kai_and_wyldfyre_31_by_fandomcraziness1_dgr39yl-fullview.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Ic2MreXuOEtrlLUXSJ4tLdO8UNrzHctg1CKS2MRjcxg)
